choke.label: Rare earth magnets
choke.fact: China made 94% of the world’s permanent magnets and did 91% of rare earth refining in 2024.

fix.note: Says it is working to control upstream parts and materials for motors.

choke.label: Gallium
choke.fact: China produced 99% of the world’s gallium in 2024. China banned exports to the US in Dec 2024, then paused the ban until Nov 27, 2026.

choke.label: Germanium
choke.fact: China produced 59% of refined germanium in 2023 and put it under the same export ban as gallium.

choke.label: Antimony
choke.fact: China mined about 60% of the world’s antimony in 2024 (USGS estimate) and included it in the 2024 export ban. Antimony goes into primers and munitions.

choke.label: Tungsten
choke.fact: China mined about 83% of the world’s tungsten in 2024. Tungsten is used for penetrators, fragmentation and the carbide cutting tools every machine shop runs on.

choke.label: Titanium sponge
choke.fact: The US produced no titanium sponge in 2025. The last domestic plant closed in 2024, and about 44,000 tonnes were imported.

choke.label: Superalloy castings
choke.fact: Turbine-grade nickel superalloy castings come from a small number of suppliers. Concentration is widely reported but not verified with a figure here.

fix.note: Re-engineers parts facing limited supply.
Licensed to build F100 engines.

choke.label: Battery materials
choke.fact: China produced 97% of the world’s battery anode materials in 2023.

fix.note: Recovers battery materials from used cells and scrap.
Developing Lithium One in East Texas.
Sodium-ion chemistry sidesteps lithium.

choke.label: Copper smelting
choke.fact: The US had only 2 operating primary copper smelters in 2025.

fix.note: Owns and is automating the Copper One mine and refinery in Utah.

choke.label: Energetics
choke.fact: Ammonium perchlorate, the oxidizer in solid rocket motors, has one qualified US producer (AMPAC, Utah). Solid rocket motor makers shrank from six to two between 1995 and 2017. The US has not made TNT since 1986; the Army awarded $435M for a Repkon USA plant in Kentucky.

fix.note: Opened a solid rocket motor factory in 2025 (TechCrunch); not in the a16z profile.
Develops propulsion in-house.

choke.label: HALEU fuel
choke.fact: The US government has long worried that Russia has a monopoly on HALEU. Centrus, the only US producer, is at demonstration scale: 20 kg delivered in Phase I, with a 900 kg target in Phase II.

fix.note: $900M DOE award to build HALEU enrichment at Paducah, KY.

choke.label: Power transformers
choke.fact: Imports were an estimated 80% of US power transformer supply in 2025. Utilities wait 2 to 4 years, and up to 5.
src: Renewable Energy World citing Wood Mackenzie, Aug 2025

fix.note: Solid-state Heron Link replaces functions of transformers.
Speeds design and construction of power infrastructure.

choke.fact: The US share of global circuit board production fell from over 30% in 2000 to 4%. China makes roughly 50% to 56% (2020).

fix.note: Cuts supplier handoffs for boards; it does not fabricate them.
